newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt exports 43,300 tonnes of cotton - traders.
newsitem.headline: Egypt exports 43,300 tonnes of cotton - traders.

text.p: Egyptian exporters said on Sunday they had sold 43,272 tonnes (132,534 bales) of cotton and that there was still international demand for Egyptian cotton seven weeks into the export season.
Egypt expects to export between 125,000 and 150,000 tonnes of this year's harvest.
"There is still demand, we've even raised prices. It's going well," an official at the Alexandria Cotton Exporters Association (Alcotexa) said.

The association, which coordinates prices and exports by state-owned and private firms, said 27 countries had bought Egyptian cotton. Earlier, Alcotexa said it had raised prices for the Giza 77 and Giza 86 varieties as supply became thin.
Prices for the seven remaining varieties were unchanged, the association said.
